full_judgment: 2. Opposite party No.1 as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 146 of 2003 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge at Sadar in Pabna against the petitioner and another for a decree of declaration that the licence dated 14-10-02 granted by defendant No. 1 for production of 'Polyron' was legal and still valid and that the registration dated 29-9-02 in the name of 'Polyron' granted by defendant No. 1 in favour of defendant No. 2 as brand name 'Iron Hydroxide Polymaltose Complex' was forged, collusive, antedated and of no legal effect.
